name: Pteridine Reductase 1 (PTR1)
notes: NADPH is ESSENTIAL -- it forms part of the active site, not an accessory. 2QHX has a co-crystal with a pteridine inhibitor, which is the best reference for placing the grid; 1E7W (methotrexate complex) is an alternative. Validated target with good crystallography, essential for pteridine and folate metabolism. It bypasses the DHFR route, which is how the parasite resists antifolates. Several inhibitor co-structures are available for protocol validation.
references: Gourley et al., 2001, Nat Struct Biol
